R7 resumed coding handoff — 2026-09-13. Performance is NOT MEASURED.

Continuous short/long executor queues are committed on `cx-reorder-R7` at `c862246cd`. The queue policy carries work across gathered batches and selects a candidate four shorts per long, with per-connection order and special-task barriers preserved. The final public surface is still `--overlap 0|1` and `--reorder 0|1`. This is a build-ready competition candidate; no win, zero-regression result, numeric break-even, or measured optimum is claimed.

The maintainer runs the scheduled box, tests, gate and merge. No server, load generator, benchmark, runtime test or gate ran during this resumed session. The resumed server change removes the bounded adapter's extra output array and redundant copies. Homogeneous spans already occupy their final positions; queued output replaces only an input prefix that submit() has fully admitted. That prefix rule is documented beside the copy and preserves the unscanned suffix and its barrier. The COPIED arm retains the pre-resume adapter for a separate measurement. The S3 preparation guard now rejects continuous R7 sources even when explicitly supplied via `--ref HEAD`; an explicit revision can no longer make the old gather hooks appear to observe the continuous scope.

Production behavior remains confined to src/core/reorder.h with owner-drain integration in src/core/ex_loop.h. The two FIFOs empty before any special task and at every owner-drain/control boundary. Read-local fairness quanta also finish their queues before local reads run. No Task remains in new scheduler state across a shard/role ownership transition. Existing owner verification, forwarding, durable deferral, immutable writes, QSBR and atomic commit paths are reused. Only live ROB heads with a short static class and no atomic hazard enter the short queue. Long entries retain their admission short-prefix frontier so a due ratio turn cannot overtake an earlier own short command. New shorts cannot extend an existing frontier. No reader retry, seqlock, in-place armed overwrite, persistent owner sidecar, or new Client/Op field was added.

Missing or unclosed captures fail; absent same-venue GET samples yield no long-attempt classification.

S1/S4: R7 adds no per-op clock, heap allocation, atomic update, persistent connection table or new request field. It does add queue copies/cursors, quota/frontier work, candidate screening and ROB-head loads on the mixed armed path. Batch witnesses reuse the existing optional statistics. Its instruction cost is not presumed zero. Reorder=0 does not enter the noinline queue path or reserve that path's stack; the additional drain guard and code placement still require PRE/POST off-arm measurement. Existing schedule statistics belong to overlap as well, so overlap=1 can allocate them even with reorder=0; the request includes overlap=0/reorder=0 controls too.

For each scored cell, cycles/op = instr/op / IPC. Required relative IPC improvement is I_POST/I_PRE; subtract one to report the percentage. The request measures policy, bypass and carry individually and together using a complete 2x2 carry/bypass decomposition, plus COPIED versus POST for the adapter change. Queue/frontier correctness guards are inseparable from the policy; unsafe mutants are never performance arms. No instruction-only or IPC-only verdict is acceptable. Break-even must be observed or bounded on the requested depth/mix grid; a mechanism that never pays in the regimes run must be deleted.

new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..eb91cda5b4570bb9a98d21280cd56f7064d1a4b6
--- /dev/null
+++ b/MEASURE-REQUEST
@@ -0,0 +1,96 @@
+NEEDS-BOX: reorder-R7 early F9 decision. No measurement has run in this lane.
+
+Use the maintainer's current gate instrument, with its perf counter window and
+matched-load ABBA controls. The lane's inherited abbagate.py only enables PMCs
+in an untrusted diagnostic path; its ordinary rate report cannot satisfy C1/S4.
+Do not substitute it for the maintainer's counter-reporting instrument.
+
+Arms (paths relative to /home/user/Projects/cx-reorder-R7):
+  PRE       build/r7-pre/build/tomokv       original 192-bucket scheduler
+  POST      build/tomokv                    R7 carry=1, homogeneous bypass=1
+  BATCH     build/r7-batch-only/build/tomokv R7 carry=0, homogeneous bypass=1
+  QUEUE     build/r7-always-queue/build/tomokv R7 carry=1, homogeneous bypass=0
+  RAW       build/r7-raw-batch/build/tomokv  R7 carry=0, homogeneous bypass=0
+  COPIED    build/r7-recovered-tomokv       R7 before bounded-adapter copy removal
+  SCOPE     build/r7-scope/build/tomokv     PRE + shared S3 observer; UNSCORED
+
+Final arm hashes and source provenance: build/r7-resume-handoff.json.
+PRE was built at 87b88cc4e before the common Git store was lost. All 191 build
+input files (src/, third_party/, Makefile) match surviving a363c2c5e exactly.
+Production POST sources survived in recovery commit 590e84384. Later scope-tool
+changes do not change the server. Each component has control.patch and a build
+manifest naming compiled objects, compiler dependencies and reused release objects.
+No data layout or deliberate placement change: no PAD arm is required for this
+candidate. Use identical-arm/code-placement controls before a sub-1% attribution.
+
+Geometry and arming:
+  Server: 32 physical cores, 0-31, no SMT. Load: physical cores 32-111, no SMT.
+  1s: 32 fused threads, 256 shards. 2s: --ratio 16:16, 128 shards, flip-auto=0.
+  Read-local=1, atomic=1, key-lb=1, client-lb=1 in EVERY deciding arm and mode;
+  verify effective INFO/CONFIG state. Historical rl0 smoke/tail cells are controls.
+  Use the gate's measured load ladder and matched offered load for each ABBA pair;
+  do not reuse an invalid pin or count a load-generator ceiling as a server result.
+  Correctness failures reproduce at --shards 16 --ratio 6:2, GATE_CORES=0-7.
+  No lane assumes a box slot. Only the maintainer launches or stops processes.
+
+Early decision, PRE vs POST, in this order (IDs in build/r7-cells.txt):
+  h15, h31                         armed GET p32, both modes
+  t05, t06                        armed 1s 8:2 GET/BITCOUNT p8, reorder on/off
+  r7-2s-tail-rl1-ro1, r7-2s-tail-rl1-ro0  same armed split pair
+  r7-off-h15, r7-off-h31            same-code-change tax with reorder=0
+These eight cells are the cheap rejection pass, not complete C4 coverage.
+
+If it survives, required PRE vs POST coverage is every row in build/r7-cells.txt:
+  The exact 17 smoke IDs, plus all 16 armed GET/SET/MGET/MSET p1/p32 cells,
+  GET/SET p8 in both modes, the armed split tail pair, 2048-connection GET p32
+  in both modes, 16 armed reorder-off counterparts, and overlap=0/reorder=0
+  GET p32 controls in both modes. No gate rows or EXPECT constants are changed.
+  Retain rate, IPC, instr/op and cycles/op on latency-scored cells too.
+
+C3 decomposition (same cells, arming, load, counters, and uncertainty treatment):
+  PRE -> RAW: two-FIFO policy plus its inseparable correctness guards.
+  RAW -> BATCH and QUEUE -> POST: homogeneous bypass, without/with carry.
+  RAW -> QUEUE and BATCH -> POST: continuous carry, without/with bypass.
+  COPIED -> POST: bounded-adapter scratch/copy removal only.
+  PRE -> POST: complete candidate. Compute C_POST - C_BATCH - C_QUEUE + C_RAW
+  per cell to expose interaction instead of assuming additivity.
+  Measure reorder=0 in every production arm to detect added fixed/placement cost.
+  The no-frontier/no-head/no-ratio/FIFO mutants are correctness controls ONLY;
+  never run those as performance-server arms.
+
+S3 uses the already built SCOPE arm before drawing a scope conclusion. Capture
+the same armed 8:2 p8 workload separately in 1s and 2s, off/on, at this geometry:
+  python3 tests/reorder_scope.py start --directory build/r7-scope
+  Record the printed window id, drive the scheduled workload, then:
+  python3 tests/reorder_scope.py stop --directory build/r7-scope
+  Gracefully stop that diagnostic server by its own PID, then:
+  python3 tests/reorder_scope.py report --directory build/r7-scope --window ID
+  Keep raw observations and report eligible/barrier/deferred/local-e0 populations,
+  actual long-attempt fraction, static-class misses, rank, position and later-short
+  opportunity. This is PRE's gather scope; it does not measure R7 cross-gather
+  residence or prove that local-read work entered the owner scheduler. No scope
+  sample, unclosed worker, or missing same-venue GET reference is a positive result.
+  Never score this observer's rate, elapsed timers, IPC or cycles as an optimization.
+
+S4, only for surviving mechanisms: build/r7-s4-cells.txt gives armed 1s/2s tails
+at p1/p8/p32 and short:long mixes 1:1, 2:1, 8:2, 8:1, 16:1. Repeat the relevant
+decomposition pair on that grid to bracket an observed load/depth/mix crossing.
+For each mechanism report fixed disarmed cost, counted instr/op delta, measured
+cycles/op delta, and the first measured regime where benefit exceeds uncertainty.
+If the grid does not bracket a crossing, report that bound; do not invent one.
+Delete a mechanism whose break-even lies outside the regimes actually run.
+
+Return MEASURE-RESULT in this worktree with the run/result paths and, per cell
+and arm: rate, IPC, instr/op, cycles/op, short-GET p99.9, long-BITCOUNT p99.9,
+offered load, completed-command denominator, effective knobs, geometry, binary
+digest and confidence/null resolution. Include misses/op and DRAM bandwidth where
+the instrument supports them to explain any retained-queue cache cost.
+
+VERDICT: cycles/op = instr/op / IPC; lower is better. Rate at matched offered load
+must agree. A higher IPC alone is never a win. Require zero regression on the
+16 armed GET/SET/MGET/MSET p1/p32 cells and no long-command starvation. An arm
+that loses in one mode must be deleted or made a measured no-op for that mode.
+Required relative IPC improvement is I_POST/I_PRE (subtract 1 for the percentage).
+The 4:1 service ratio is only a candidate inferred from the target 8:2 mix; it is
+not a measured optimum. No development CLI/config/env knobs survive. The measured
+hardcode/delete verdict and all numeric performance claims remain PENDING.
diff --git a/build/r7_build_arms.py b/build/r7_build_arms.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..702033e805743d0a4641118a4ec76b16182471ab
--- /dev/null
+++ b/build/r7_build_arms.py
@@ -0,0 +1,134 @@
+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Build R7 source controls only; never execute a server, test, or load driver.
+
+Reuse a release object only when compiler-generated dependencies prove its source
+and includes identical to the completed base build. Record every reuse and command.
+All snapshots, objects, logs, and manifests remain inside this worktree's build/.
+"""
+import concurrent.futures
+import difflib
+import hashlib
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+import shlex
+import shutil
+import subprocess
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
+REVISION = "590e84384d7282c389beb8a13ff06b06f3e021aa"
+SNAPSHOT = ROOT / "build/r7-post-source"
+
+
+def run(argv, cwd=ROOT):
+    return subprocess.check_output(argv, cwd=cwd, text=True)
+
+
+def digest(path):
+    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
+
+
+def replace_once(source, before, after):
+    if source.count(before) != 1:
+        raise ValueError(f"source anchor changed: {before!r}")
+    return source.replace(before, after, 1)
+
+
+def prepare(name, carry, bypass):
+    dest = ROOT / "build" / ("r7-" + name)
+    dest.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
+    for directory in ("src", "third_party"):
+        shutil.copytree(SNAPSHOT / directory, dest / directory)
+    shutil.copy2(SNAPSHOT / "Makefile", dest / "Makefile")
+    path = dest / "src/core/reorder.h"
+    before = source = path.read_text()
+    if not bypass:
+        source = replace_once(source,
+            "            bool one_client = true, one_class = true;\n"
+            "            const bool first_long = lengths[begin] ==\n"
+            "                static_cast<uint8_t>(CommandLengthClass::Long);\n",
+            "            bool one_client = true;\n")
+        source = replace_once(source,
+            "                one_class &= (lengths[end] == static_cast<uint8_t>(CommandLengthClass::Long)) ==\n"
+            "                             first_long;\n", "")
+        source = replace_once(source, "if (!size() && (one_client || one_class))",
+                              "if (!size() && one_client)")
+    if not carry:
+        source = replace_once(source,
+            "            begin = end + (end < n);\n        }\n    }\n};",
+            "            begin = end + (end < n);\n        }\n        finish(emit);\n    }\n};")
+    path.write_text(source)
+    (dest / "control.patch").write_text("".join(difflib.unified_diff(
+        before.splitlines(True), source.splitlines(True),
+        fromfile="a/src/core/reorder.h", tofile="b/src/core/reorder.h")))
+    (dest / "control.json").write_text(json.dumps(dict(source_revision=REVISION,
+        carry=carry, homogeneous_bypass=bypass, correctness_guards="unchanged"), indent=2) + "\n")
+    return dest
+
+
+def build(dest, base):
+    plan = [shlex.split(line) for line in run(["make", "-nB", "all"], dest).splitlines()]
+    compiles = [cmd for cmd in plan if "-c" in cmd and "-o" in cmd]
+    links = [cmd for cmd in plan if "-o" in cmd and "-c" not in cmd]
+    if len(links) != 1 or not compiles:
+        raise ValueError("Makefile compile/link plan changed")
+    changes = set()
+    for directory in ("src", "third_party"):
+        for path in (dest / directory).rglob("*"):
+            if path.is_file():
+                relative = path.relative_to(dest)
+                if not (base / relative).is_file() or digest(path) != digest(base / relative):
+                    changes.add(str(relative))
+    records, rebuild = [], []
+    for command in compiles:
+        source = command[command.index("-c") + 1]
+        obj = command[command.index("-o") + 1]
+        dep_command = command.copy()
+        at = dep_command.index("-o")
+        del dep_command[at:at + 2]
+        dep_command[dep_command.index("-c")] = "-MM"
+        dependencies = set(shlex.split(run(dep_command, dest).split(":", 1)[1].replace("\\\n", " ")))
+        affected = sorted(dependencies & changes)
+        (dest / obj).parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+        record = dict(source=source, object=obj, compile_argv=command, affected=affected)
+        if affected:
+            rebuild.append((command, obj))
+        else:
+            shutil.copy2(base / obj, dest / obj)
+            record.update(reused_from=str(base / obj), sha256=digest(base / obj))
+        records.append(record)
+    print(f"{dest.name}: compile {len(rebuild)}, reuse {len(compiles) - len(rebuild)}", flush=True)
+
+    def compile_one(item):
+        command, obj = item
+        with (dest / (obj + ".log")).open("w") as log:
+            subprocess.run(command, cwd=dest, stdout=log, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, check=True)
+        return obj
+
+    with concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=2) as pool:
+        for obj in pool.map(compile_one, rebuild):
+            print(f"{dest.name}: compiled {obj}", flush=True)
+    with (dest / "build/link.log").open("w") as log:
+        subprocess.run(links[0], cwd=dest, stdout=log, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, check=True)
+    manifest = dict(base_directory=str(base), base_binary_sha256=digest(base / "build/tomokv"),
+        source_revision=REVISION if base == ROOT else "a363c2c5e1f16e98db18e15dd427502093f99f7c",
+        changed_files=sorted(changes), objects=records, link_argv=links[0],

+  PRE -> RAW: two-FIFO policy plus its inseparable correctness guards.
+  RAW -> BATCH and QUEUE -> POST: homogeneous bypass, without/with carry.
+  RAW -> QUEUE and BATCH -> POST: continuous carry, without/with bypass.

diff --git a/build/r7_build_arms.py b/build/r7_build_arms.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..702033e805743d0a4641118a4ec76b16182471ab
--- /dev/null
+++ b/build/r7_build_arms.py
@@ -0,0 +1,134 @@
+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Build R7 source controls only; never execute a server, test, or load driver.
+
+Reuse a release object only when compiler-generated dependencies prove its source
+and includes identical to the completed base build. Record every reuse and command.
+All snapshots, objects, logs, and manifests remain inside this worktree's build/.
+"""
+import concurrent.futures
+import difflib
+import hashlib
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+import shlex
+import shutil
+import subprocess
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
+REVISION = "590e84384d7282c389beb8a13ff06b06f3e021aa"
+SNAPSHOT = ROOT / "build/r7-post-source"
+
+
+def run(argv, cwd=ROOT):
+    return subprocess.check_output(argv, cwd=cwd, text=True)
+
+
+def digest(path):
+    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
+
+
+def replace_once(source, before, after):
+    if source.count(before) != 1:
+        raise ValueError(f"source anchor changed: {before!r}")
+    return source.replace(before, after, 1)
+
+
+def prepare(name, carry, bypass):
+    dest = ROOT / "build" / ("r7-" + name)
+    dest.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
+    for directory in ("src", "third_party"):
+        shutil.copytree(SNAPSHOT / directory, dest / directory)
+    shutil.copy2(SNAPSHOT / "Makefile", dest / "Makefile")
+    path = dest / "src/core/reorder.h"
+    before = source = path.read_text()
+    if not bypass:
+        source = replace_once(source,
+            "            bool one_client = true, one_class = true;\n"
+            "            const bool first_long = lengths[begin] ==\n"
+            "                static_cast<uint8_t>(CommandLengthClass::Long);\n",
+            "            bool one_client = true;\n")
+        source = replace_once(source,
+            "                one_class &= (lengths[end] == static_cast<uint8_t>(CommandLengthClass::Long)) ==\n"
+            "                             first_long;\n", "")
+        source = replace_once(source, "if (!size() && (one_client || one_class))",
+                              "if (!size() && one_client)")
+    if not carry:
+        source = replace_once(source,
+            "            begin = end + (end < n);\n        }\n    }\n};",
+            "            begin = end + (end < n);\n        }\n        finish(emit);\n    }\n};")
+    path.write_text(source)
+    (dest / "control.patch").write_text("".join(difflib.unified_diff(
+        before.splitlines(True), source.splitlines(True),
+        fromfile="a/src/core/reorder.h", tofile="b/src/core/reorder.h")))
+    (dest / "control.json").write_text(json.dumps(dict(source_revision=REVISION,
+        carry=carry, homogeneous_bypass=bypass, correctness_guards="unchanged"), indent=2) + "\n")
+    return dest
+
+
+def build(dest, base):
+    plan = [shlex.split(line) for line in run(["make", "-nB", "all"], dest).splitlines()]
+    compiles = [cmd for cmd in plan if "-c" in cmd and "-o" in cmd]
+    links = [cmd for cmd in plan if "-o" in cmd and "-c" not in cmd]
+    if len(links) != 1 or not compiles:
+        raise ValueError("Makefile compile/link plan changed")
+    changes = set()
+    for directory in ("src", "third_party"):
+        for path in (dest / directory).rglob("*"):
+            if path.is_file():
+                relative = path.relative_to(dest)
+                if not (base / relative).is_file() or digest(path) != digest(base / relative):
+                    changes.add(str(relative))
+    records, rebuild = [], []
+    for command in compiles:
+        source = command[command.index("-c") + 1]
+        obj = command[command.index("-o") + 1]
+        dep_command = command.copy()
+        at = dep_command.index("-o")
+        del dep_command[at:at + 2]
+        dep_command[dep_command.index("-c")] = "-MM"
+        dependencies = set(shlex.split(run(dep_command, dest).split(":", 1)[1].replace("\\\n", " ")))
+        affected = sorted(dependencies & changes)
+        (dest / obj).parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+        record = dict(source=source, object=obj, compile_argv=command, affected=affected)
+        if affected:
+            rebuild.append((command, obj))
+        else:
+            shutil.copy2(base / obj, dest / obj)
+            record.update(reused_from=str(base / obj), sha256=digest(base / obj))
+        records.append(record)
+    print(f"{dest.name}: compile {len(rebuild)}, reuse {len(compiles) - len(rebuild)}", flush=True)
+
+    def compile_one(item):
+        command, obj = item
+        with (dest / (obj + ".log")).open("w") as log:
+            subprocess.run(command, cwd=dest, stdout=log, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, check=True)
+        return obj
+
+    with concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=2) as pool:
+        for obj in pool.map(compile_one, rebuild):
+            print(f"{dest.name}: compiled {obj}", flush=True)
+    with (dest / "build/link.log").open("w") as log:
+        subprocess.run(links[0], cwd=dest, stdout=log, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, check=True)
+    manifest = dict(base_directory=str(base), base_binary_sha256=digest(base / "build/tomokv"),
+        source_revision=REVISION if base == ROOT else "a363c2c5e1f16e98db18e15dd427502093f99f7c",
+        changed_files=sorted(changes), objects=records, link_argv=links[0],
+        binary=str(dest / "build/tomokv"), sha256=digest(dest / "build/tomokv"),
+        build_status="PASS", execution="NOT RUN")
+    (dest / "build-manifest.json").write_text(json.dumps(manifest, indent=2) + "\n")
+    print(f"{dest.name}: LINK PASS {manifest['sha256']}", flush=True)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    # Run only after the main POST build has completed successfully.
+    # The store recovery preserved these production sources in REVISION. Freeze
+    # them locally so another common-store interruption cannot lose build inputs.
+    SNAPSHOT.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
+    for directory in ("src", "third_party", "tests"):
+        shutil.copytree(ROOT / directory, SNAPSHOT / directory,
+                        ignore=shutil.ignore_patterns("__pycache__"))
+    shutil.copy2(ROOT / "Makefile", SNAPSHOT / "Makefile")
+    for name, carry, bypass in (("batch-only", False, True),
+                                ("always-queue", True, False),
+                                ("raw-batch", False, False)):
+        build(prepare(name, carry, bypass), ROOT)
+    build(ROOT / "build/r7-scope", ROOT / "build/r7-pre")

     if (__builtin_expect(n > BatchOps, false)) std::abort();
     ExReorderQueues<BatchOps> queues;
-    Task output[BatchOps];
     uint32_t count = 0;
     ReorderResult result;

         result.multi_client_runs += witness.multi_client_runs;
         result.permuted_runs += witness.permuted_runs;
-        for (uint32_t i = 0; i < size; i++) output[count++] = selected[i];
+        if (__builtin_expect(size > n - count, false)) std::abort();
+        // submit() has admitted every source entry in this output prefix before calling us.
+        // A queued emission can therefore replace it now without touching an unscanned suffix
+        // or barrier. Bypassed spans already occupy their final position and need no Task copy.
+        if (selected != tasks + count)
+            for (uint32_t i = 0; i < size; i++) tasks[count + i] = selected[i];
+        count += size;
     };
     queues.submit(tasks, n, emit);
     queues.finish(emit);
     if (count != n) std::abort();
-    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < n; i++) tasks[i] = output[i];
     return result;
 }

index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..702033e805743d0a4641118a4ec76b16182471ab
--- /dev/null
+++ b/build/r7_build_arms.py
@@ -0,0 +1,134 @@
+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Build R7 source controls only; never execute a server, test, or load driver.
+
+Reuse a release object only when compiler-generated dependencies prove its source
+and includes identical to the completed base build. Record every reuse and command.
+All snapshots, objects, logs, and manifests remain inside this worktree's build/.
+"""
+import concurrent.futures
+import difflib
+import hashlib
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+import shlex
+import shutil
+import subprocess
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
+REVISION = "590e84384d7282c389beb8a13ff06b06f3e021aa"
+SNAPSHOT = ROOT / "build/r7-post-source"
+
+
+def run(argv, cwd=ROOT):
+    return subprocess.check_output(argv, cwd=cwd, text=True)
+
+
+def digest(path):
+    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
+
+
+def replace_once(source, before, after):
+    if source.count(before) != 1:
+        raise ValueError(f"source anchor changed: {before!r}")
+    return source.replace(before, after, 1)
+
+
+def prepare(name, carry, bypass):
+    dest = ROOT / "build" / ("r7-" + name)
+    dest.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
+    for directory in ("src", "third_party"):
+        shutil.copytree(SNAPSHOT / directory, dest / directory)
+    shutil.copy2(SNAPSHOT / "Makefile", dest / "Makefile")
+    path = dest / "src/core/reorder.h"
+    before = source = path.read_text()
+    if not bypass:
+        source = replace_once(source,
+            "            bool one_client = true, one_class = true;\n"
+            "            const bool first_long = lengths[begin] ==\n"
+            "                static_cast<uint8_t>(CommandLengthClass::Long);\n",
+            "            bool one_client = true;\n")
+        source = replace_once(source,
+            "                one_class &= (lengths[end] == static_cast<uint8_t>(CommandLengthClass::Long)) ==\n"
+            "                             first_long;\n", "")
+        source = replace_once(source, "if (!size() && (one_client || one_class))",
+                              "if (!size() && one_client)")
+    if not carry:
+        source = replace_once(source,
+            "            begin = end + (end < n);\n        }\n    }\n};",
+            "            begin = end + (end < n);\n        }\n        finish(emit);\n    }\n};")
+    path.write_text(source)
+    (dest / "control.patch").write_text("".join(difflib.unified_diff(
+        before.splitlines(True), source.splitlines(True),
+        fromfile="a/src/core/reorder.h", tofile="b/src/core/reorder.h")))
+    (dest / "control.json").write_text(json.dumps(dict(source_revision=REVISION,
+        carry=carry, homogeneous_bypass=bypass, correctness_guards="unchanged"), indent=2) + "\n")
+    return dest
+
+
+def build(dest, base):
+    plan = [shlex.split(line) for line in run(["make", "-nB", "all"], dest).splitlines()]
+    compiles = [cmd for cmd in plan if "-c" in cmd and "-o" in cmd]
+    links = [cmd for cmd in plan if "-o" in cmd and "-c" not in cmd]
+    if len(links) != 1 or not compiles:
+        raise ValueError("Makefile compile/link plan changed")
+    changes = set()
+    for directory in ("src", "third_party"):
+        for path in (dest / directory).rglob("*"):
+            if path.is_file():
+                relative = path.relative_to(dest)
+                if not (base / relative).is_file() or digest(path) != digest(base / relative):
+                    changes.add(str(relative))
+    records, rebuild = [], []
+    for command in compiles:
+        source = command[command.index("-c") + 1]
+        obj = command[command.index("-o") + 1]
+        dep_command = command.copy()
+        at = dep_command.index("-o")
+        del dep_command[at:at + 2]
+        dep_command[dep_command.index("-c")] = "-MM"
+        dependencies = set(shlex.split(run(dep_command, dest).split(":", 1)[1].replace("\\\n", " ")))
+        affected = sorted(dependencies & changes)
+        (dest / obj).parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+        record = dict(source=source, object=obj, compile_argv=command, affected=affected)
+        if affected:
+            rebuild.append((command, obj))
+        else:
+            shutil.copy2(base / obj, dest / obj)
+            record.update(reused_from=str(base / obj), sha256=digest(base / obj))
+        records.append(record)
+    print(f"{dest.name}: compile {len(rebuild)}, reuse {len(compiles) - len(rebuild)}", flush=True)
+
+    def compile_one(item):
+        command, obj = item
+        with (dest / (obj + ".log")).open("w") as log:
+            subprocess.run(command, cwd=dest, stdout=log, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, check=True)
+        return obj
+
+    with concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=2) as pool:
+        for obj in pool.map(compile_one, rebuild):
+            print(f"{dest.name}: compiled {obj}", flush=True)
+    with (dest / "build/link.log").open("w") as log:
+        subprocess.run(links[0], cwd=dest, stdout=log, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, check=True)
+    manifest = dict(base_directory=str(base), base_binary_sha256=digest(base / "build/tomokv"),
+        source_revision=REVISION if base == ROOT else "a363c2c5e1f16e98db18e15dd427502093f99f7c",
+        changed_files=sorted(changes), objects=records, link_argv=links[0],
+        binary=str(dest / "build/tomokv"), sha256=digest(dest / "build/tomokv"),
+        build_status="PASS", execution="NOT RUN")
+    (dest / "build-manifest.json").write_text(json.dumps(manifest, indent=2) + "\n")
+    print(f"{dest.name}: LINK PASS {manifest['sha256']}", flush=True)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    # Run only after the main POST build has completed successfully.
+    # The store recovery preserved these production sources in REVISION. Freeze
+    # them locally so another common-store interruption cannot lose build inputs.
+    SNAPSHOT.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
+    for directory in ("src", "third_party", "tests"):
+        shutil.copytree(ROOT / directory, SNAPSHOT / directory,
+                        ignore=shutil.ignore_patterns("__pycache__"))
+    shutil.copy2(ROOT / "Makefile", SNAPSHOT / "Makefile")
+    for name, carry, bypass in (("batch-only", False, True),
+                                ("always-queue", True, False),
+                                ("raw-batch", False, False)):
+        build(prepare(name, carry, bypass), ROOT)
+    build(ROOT / "build/r7-scope", ROOT / "build/r7-pre")
diff --git a/src/core/reorder.h b/src/core/reorder.h
index 8739c199d19244671b3c56278c3658b4be2a3a5b..7f627bae6ee4851e20a6a64c6ceeabd7ebde48e3
--- a/src/core/reorder.h
+++ b/src/core/reorder.h
@@ -211,18 +211,22 @@
 __attribute__((noinline)) ReorderResult ex_schedule_batch(Task (&tasks)[BatchOps], uint32_t n) {
     if (__builtin_expect(n > BatchOps, false)) std::abort();
     ExReorderQueues<BatchOps> queues;
-    Task output[BatchOps];
     uint32_t count = 0;
     ReorderResult result;
     auto emit = [&](const Task* selected, uint32_t size, ReorderResult witness) {
         result.multi_client_runs += witness.multi_client_runs;
         result.permuted_runs += witness.permuted_runs;
-        for (uint32_t i = 0; i < size; i++) output[count++] = selected[i];
+        if (__builtin_expect(size > n - count, false)) std::abort();
+        // submit() has admitted every source entry in this output prefix before calling us.
+        // A queued emission can therefore replace it now without touching an unscanned suffix
+        // or barrier. Bypassed spans already occupy their final position and need no Task copy.
+        if (selected != tasks + count)
+            for (uint32_t i = 0; i < size; i++) tasks[count + i] = selected[i];
+        count += size;
     };
     queues.submit(tasks, n, emit);
     queues.finish(emit);
     if (count != n) std::abort();
-    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < n; i++) tasks[i] = output[i];
     return result;
 }
